newsitem.title: USA: ComEd 1,105 MW Bryon 2 nuke unit fully back.
newsitem.headline: ComEd 1,105 MW Bryon 2 nuke unit fully back.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's 1,105 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at its Bryon nuclear generating facility resumed full production, Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Monday.
Production at the unit, in Bryon, Ill., was reduced Thursday to about 50 percent while crews replaced a feedwater pump.
The neighboring Bryon unit 1, also at 1,105 MW, was operating at 97 percent of capacity, NRC said.
The company continued to increase output at its 794 MW Dresden 2 nuclear unit, NRC said.
The Morris, Ill., unit was running at 87 percent power following weekend testing of its turbine control valve.
ComEd is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
